description: List everything Formquote has price evidence for: email verification credit packs and plans (MillionVerifier, Reoon, DeBounce, Emailable), sound effect packs (SoundMorph, HISSandaROAR, Thomas Rex Beverly Audio) and font licences (Pangram Pangram, Fontwerk, Grilli Type, Fontfabric), with each listed price, billing period, the date it was checked and the seller’s page. Use this to see what is covered, or when the user asks for one of these suppliers’ listed prices. To price a specific need, use the compare_* tools instead.

category.description: Only this category (optional; default all three).

lang.description: Language of the Formquote page linked in the answer (en, zh, ja, fr, de). The figures are the same; notes recorded by Formquote stay in their original language (mostly Chinese).
